Nagaland.fact: Nagaland () is a state in the north-eastern region of India.  It is bordered by the Indian states of Arunachal Pradesh to the north, Assam to the west, Manipur to the south, and the Naga Self-Administered Zone of the Sagaing Region of Myanmar (Burma) to the east.  Its capital city is Kohima and its largest city is the twin Chümoukedima–Dimapur.  The state has an area of 16,579 square kilometres (6,401 sq mi) with a population of 1,980,602 as per the 2011 Census of India, making it one of the least populated states in India.  Nagaland consists of 17 administrative districts, inhabited by 17 major tribes along with other sub-tribes.  Each tribe is distinct in character from the other in terms of customs, language and dress

Perfect Master (Meher Baba).fact: Ramakrishna elaborates "When I think of the Supreme Being as inactive - neither creating nor preserving nor destroying - I call Him Brahman or Purusha, the Impersonal God.

Perfect Master (Meher Baba).subject: Indian States
Perfect Master (Meher Baba).question: When I think of Him as active - creating, preserving, and destroying - I call _____ or Maya or Prakriti, the Personal God
Perfect Master (Meher Baba).fact: When I think of Him as active - creating, preserving, and destroying - I call Him Sakti or Maya or Prakriti, the Personal God.

Perfect Master (Meher Baba).question: The Divine Mother and _____ are one."
